headline: The 10-year Treasury closed Tuesday at 4.99%, down 13 basis points week over week.
The Fed announces its rate decision Wednesday afternoon, with futures pricing a hold at better than 90%.
Shorenstein bought the fully leased 148 Lafayette Street office building in SoHo from Tishman Speyer for $132.5 million.
Japan's Takenaka is under contract to purchase One Broadway for $170 million.
A three-building walkup complex in Kips Bay sold for $12 million, under half its 2015 price.
